text:
maya: Quick copy check — new inline note under the Model precision dropdown. Screenshot: https://redwood.example/screenshot.png. Need short tooltip + a one-line empty-state for when KV cache is unavailable (private deploys). Posting 3 variants, please react with the number you prefer and any tiny wording nits.

maya: Options:```1) "Model precision: lower precision reduces cost and latency; output may be slightly different." (aria: "Model precision may affect fidelity and cost.")
2) "Model precision: lower precision can be faster and cheaper; outputs may lose detail." (aria: "Lower precision may alter output detail.")
3) "Model precision — choose speed or fidelity. Lower precision = faster, cheaper, possibly less detail." (aria: "Choose precision with tradeoffs between speed and output fidelity.")```

darren: quick read — 2 feels clearest. but i think "lose detail" sounds a little informal. maybe "reduce detail"? :thinking: 

evan: I prefer 2 too. Suggest swapping "outputs may lose detail" -> "outputs may have reduced detail" for tone + accessibility. Also check character length; tooltip max width is small.

showk: small a11y nit — avoid starting tooltip text with a verb phrase. Something like "Lower precision can be faster and cheaper; outputs may have reduced detail." is fine. Also add an info icon with `aria-describedby` pointing to the tooltip id so screen readers announce it.

design-bot: a11y-scan: tooltip text length 94 chars; contrast of tooltip background vs text passes. recommends linking to docs for full tradeoffs.

danny: engineering constraint — tooltip width is constrained to 220px, ~60-70 chars visible without wrapping. If we keep option 2, we should prepare a one-line compact variant for the UI: "Lower precision = faster, cheaper. May reduce output detail."

maya: good point. here's my proposed tooltip final (compact) and an empty-state line for KV cache disabled:```Tooltip (compact): "Lower precision = faster, cheaper. May reduce output detail."Empty state (KV cache disabled): "KV cache disabled for this deployment. Responses may be slower; caching helps reduce cost and improve latency. Learn more → https://redwood.example/kv-cache"```

evan: LGTM. Change request: use "KV cache" (capital K/V) for readability and consistency across console. Also the empty-state sentence "caching helps reduce cost and improve latency" is great — maybe reorder to emphasize latency first: "Responses may be slower; caching reduces latency and cost."

darren: +1 on capitalization. tiny nit: remove the period after the arrow in the Learn more link label (so it doesn't read like a sentence).

maya: Updated:```Tooltip: "Lower precision = faster, cheaper. May reduce output detail."Empty state: "KV cache disabled for this deployment. Responses may be slower; caching reduces latency and cost. Learn more → https://redwood.example/kv-cache"```Planned placement: tooltip on hover of the precision label; empty state shown inline under the Model settings when cache unavailable.

danny: implementation ok from my side. will ensure tooltip has `role=\"tooltip\"` and is reachable by keyboard.

evan: :thumbsup:

darren: approving copy. small follow-up: can we also include this as a short note in the release notes UI? just 1 line.

maya: will add to release notes. thanks everyone!
